card.name: Just before power plant words
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or numbers right before an expected power plant or reactor term, such as 'at the nuclear plants' or 'a single 500 megawatt coal-fired'. The setting is news or science text about energy and power stations.

modes.label: Linking word before plants
modes.description: A short word like at or of that comes just before a power plant, reactor or cooling facility.
modes.example: The quake has not caused any major problems<< at>> the nuclear power plants in nearby Fukushima prefect

modes.label: Number or space before a plant
modes.description: A space or digit inside a count or size that is followed by a plant, reactor or coal-fired unit.
modes.example: operations at all the nation’s<< >>54 nuclear reactors have been gradually suspended

modes.label: Plant-related names
modes.description: A place or company name in a nuclear or power plant setting.
modes.example: meltdowns at the<< Fukushima>> Daiichi reactors last year

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for power stations and heavy industry, such as nuclear, power plant, coal mine and refinery.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a power plant or reactor is named in energy news.
